items.title: Is This Wall Street Bank Insane to Believe Tesla Will Nearly Double From Current Prices? Maybe Not.
items.summary: Wedbush just slapped a $600 price target on a stock that missed earnings by nearly 40% and watched its operating margin crater to almost nothing. The audacity either marks a Wall Street analyst losing the plot or someone who sees a business model transformation the rest of the market is too impatient to price in.
